invariantStatement: No candidate may cause a GT semantic unit to receive HONESTLY_UNRESOLVED, HONESTLY_UNSUPPORTED, DISCOVERED_REVIEW_REQUIRED (V2's REVIEW_REQUIRED-equivalent 'flag counts' state), AMBIGUOUS, or any equivalent safe/no-credit accounting state, unless the candidate itself has sufficient semantic correspondence to the SPECIFIC GT claim. Structural proximity, same section, ancestor/descendant relationship, same covenant family, generic uncertainty, and shared terminology alone are all insufficient.

twoStageTest.stageA_claimCorrespondence: Does this candidate correspond to the GT claim sufficiently to establish that Headroom identified the relevant semantic subject? Evaluated across the dimensions actually present/asserted in the GT claim (subject/action, legal posture, object/resource, covenant family, entity scope, economics, defined term/metric, condition/exception, dependency/cross-reference, temporal/operative qualifier).
twoStageTest.stageB_representationState: Only if Stage A passes (YES or a genuinely justified PARTIAL) may Stage B be considered: what did Headroom do with that corresponding claim (VERIFIED/UNVERIFIED representation, PARTIAL representation, REVIEW REQUIRED, UNRESOLVED, UNSUPPORTED, AMBIGUOUS).

rootCauseIdentifiedFromForensics.mechanism: lib/contract-model/evaluation-v2/semantic-correspondence.ts's assessDimensions() computes three CORE_CREDIT_DIMENSIONS: A_SUBJECT_ACTION, B_LEGAL_POSTURE, C_OBJECT_RESOURCE. Dimension A returns NOT_APPLICABLE whenever the GT claim's extracted action list is empty (`gtActions.length === 0`); dimension B returns NOT_APPLICABLE whenever the GT claim's legal posture is UNDETERMINED. Both conditions are COMMON for definitional units, representation-style claims, and other omnibus/factual provisions that do not have a clean restrictive/permissive action verb. When BOTH A and B are NOT_APPLICABLE, C_OBJECT_RESOURCE becomes the SOLE dimension responsible for the entire correspondence determination (matching.ts's `coreAllPresent` check requires all three core dimensions to be CORRESPONDS or NOT_APPLICABLE - with A and B auto-satisfied via NOT_APPLICABLE, only C's outcome decides the pair).
rootCauseIdentifiedFromForensics.whyCIsInsufficientAlone: C_OBJECT_RESOURCE's CORRESPONDS outcome is granted via lexical shared-term overlap (lib/contract-model/evaluation-v2/signals.ts's overlapDetail(), coefficient = sharedCount / min(setA.size, setB.size) - normalized against the SMALLER term set, not the union). For a SHORT candidate excerpt with few extracted content terms, sharing only 3-4 common contract-boilerplate terms (e.g. 'Lien', 'Loan Party', 'Restricted Subsidiary', a shared Section reference) with the GT claim can clear the coefficient threshold (0.3 primary path, or 0.12 with family-match support requiring only 3 shared terms) even though the candidate addresses a completely different legal subject. This single-dimension, lexical-overlap-only correspondence path is what admitted 27 of 31 forensically-confirmed false-safe-surfacing cases (01-credit-neutral-disagreement-forensics.json) and is the same mechanism implicated in the definitional over-match defect (03-definition-overmatch-root-cause.json).
rootCauseIdentifiedFromForensics.evidenceForThisMechanism: 20 of 27 false-safe-surfacing cases relied on V2's matchedCandidateIds selection (the single 'best' scoring candidate via this exact pathway); the identical candidate ID (coverage-unit:0b33f42d...) was independently relied upon by V2 to justify HONESTLY_UNRESOLVED credit for TWO unrelated GT claims (doc-a::III::3.03-no-conflicts, a Governmental-Approvals/no-conflicts representation, and doc-a::VI::6.02h, a customs/bankers-acceptances Liens exception) - the second-pass reviewer independently judged NO correspondence for this candidate against BOTH claims, reading it correctly as a Section 6.02(j)(i) Liens carve-out unrelated to either.

generalizedFixDesign.principle: The fewer independent dimensions can vouch for a candidate's correspondence to a claim, the stronger the remaining evidence must be before correspondence is credited. This is a structural, evidentiary rule - it references no term, package, document, or covenant family.
generalizedFixDesign.mechanism: When A_SUBJECT_ACTION and B_LEGAL_POSTURE are BOTH NOT_APPLICABLE for a given pair (i.e., C_OBJECT_RESOURCE would be the sole carrier of the correspondence determination), apply a materially stricter object/resource correspondence bar: remove the family-match-assisted lower threshold path entirely (that path exists specifically to let a WEAKER lexical signal count when a covenant-family match already provides independent corroboration - but there is no such independent corroboration when A and B are both silent), and raise the primary-path coefficient/shared-term-count requirements.
generalizedFixDesign.appliesTo: This changes the deterministic Layer 2 correspondence classification (semantic-correspondence.ts) uniformly for every pair evaluated, for every dataset - not a safe-surfacing-only patch layered on top. A pair that no longer qualifies as CORRESPONDS_FULLY/PARTIALLY under the stricter sole-dimension bar correctly falls back to INDETERMINATE (eligible for live-judge referral) or NO_CORRESPONDENCE, which correctly removes it from BOTH representation credit AND matching.ts's safe-surfacing eligibility (honestUnresolved / correspondingSafetyFlags / correspondingInventoryOnly / substantiveFull / substantivePartial all draw from the same `corresponding` pool).
generalizedFixDesign.explicitlyNotDone: Did not add a special-cased check for 'DEFINITION unitType', 'Acquisition', 'Article X', DSGR, or any package/term identifier. The fix keys ONLY on the already-computed, fully generic dimension-outcome pattern (A and B both NOT_APPLICABLE), which arises whenever a claim's own text does not yield a clean action/posture signal - true for many claim shapes across every dataset, never checked by name.

safeSurfacingVsRepresentationPreserved.note: Preserves the Phase 3F.1.5.1 taxonomy distinction unchanged: correctly surfaced-but-uncompiled discovery candidates (SAFE_SURFACING=YES, SEMANTIC_REPRESENTATION=NO) and correctly surfaced-but-unsupported candidates remain distinct from unrelated nearby unresolved candidates (SAFE_SURFACING=NO). This phase's fix operates entirely upstream of that distinction, at the correspondence-determination layer that decides whether a candidate is ABOUT the claim at all - it does not touch the discovery-vs-representation accounting gate in matching.ts, which Phase 3F.1.5.1 already validated is working correctly (doc-a::VI::6.10-chapeau).
